sd_library.name: KONTAKTS SD Application Library
sd_library.description: Widgets, system wiki/help and offline UPDATE content. Download the ZIP and extract it into the root of the FAT32 SD card; do not flash it to ESP32. The current App11 snapshot includes USB Serial Terminal and its HTML Help pages.

firmwares.name: KONTAKTS Platform / USB Serial Terminal
firmwares.status: PHYSICAL PASS / WEB FLASHER PHYSICAL PASS
firmwares.description: Current KONTAKTS Web Flasher baseline with SYS | SD | WIDGET, SD Help Center, Widget Runtime and the generic UART0 serial service used by USB Serial Terminal. On Sample A the normal USB -> CH340C -> UART0 path was physically exercised in both directions, the 0.3.5 browser Web Flasher full install was physically accepted, and the app-only GitHub OTA path was physically regression-tested from 0.3.5 to 0.3.6 with saved Wi-Fi/NVS preserved.
